name: VNET/On-Prem support for Eventstream Connectors
description: The Eventstream streaming connector in Fabric Real-Time Intelligence enables the ingestion of real-time data from various sources into Fabric. This VNET/On-Prem support feature extends the streaming source’s environment from public networks to private networks, such as cloud virtual networks or on-premises networks.

result.nameEs: Compatibilidad con VNet y entornos locales en los conectores de Eventstream
